slides.text: Provenance: where did this actually come from? SLSA Sigstore Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts Signing, without a key to guard forever Checkable metadata showing which source repository and build pipeline produced an artefact. Signs the artefact with a short-lived certificate tied to the CI identity that built it. git blame , but for the finished thing you installed. Not a private key someone has to protect indefinitely. 26
